Name: Unique Horses by CC
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center][b][size=6]﻿Unique Horses by CC[/size][/b]

[i][size=3]Unique horses for a unique farmer[/size][/i][/center]
                                                                                                                [img]https://i.imgur.com/8gSKVMb.gif[/img]

[center]This mod is an update and complete overhaul of my previous mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6405]CC's Horse Plus[/url]. (which is outdated now). The goal is to offer a well-animated horse that is balanced and vanilla-friendly, while also visually compatible with other animal replacement mods.  Each breed of horse has unique small details to give them big personality. 

[size=3][b]2.0 Update:
[/b][/size]- Fixed issue with Ghost horse tilesheet
- Major stray sprite cleanup, pixel smoothing, and outline changes for every horse
- Overhaul of the Stallion
-Added two new horse types, Void and Icelandic[/center]

[size=5][b]How to Use:
[/b][/size][b]﻿CP Version:[/b]
- Download the zip file
- Unzip the file into your Mods folder
- Load up the game with the mod installed
- Choose coat color and saddle/bareback in the config.json file
[b]Make sure you have the latest version of Content Patcher installed![/b]

[b]I highly suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to also adjust horse color from within the game![/b]

[size=5][b]Known Issues:
[/b][/size]- Horses cannot wear hats :( well they can, just not well


[size=5][b]Compatibilities:[/b][/size]
- Confirmed to be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul
[/url]- Fully 1.6 compatible with carrot eating animations.


[size=5][b]Credits:[/b][/size]
- Kudos to[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/39003995?tab=user+files] Elle's mods[/url] in general for giving me a template for C++ coding
- Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261]this mod[/url] for helping with the running animation
- Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17245?tab=description]Green's mod[/url] that inspired a lot of the bigger changes and helped me figure out the bobbing head/taller horse part of the tilesheet.
